_meta.notes: Chunk file's flag 'listing label November' VERIFIED and it disagrees with the form's report TYPE: the cover checks 'Seven days before a general election'; the signature date is Nov 1, 2016, the clerk stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE NOV 01 2016 and every schedule page is self-dated 11-1-16, which is where the listing's 'November' comes from. Form governs. Cover fields otherwise AGREE with the chunk file: Samuel F. Granato, County Council, District Number 4 (the cover fills BOTH the top-row 'Office' and the separate 'Office Sought'). Neither amendment box is ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. THE FILER CORRECTED HIS OWN SUMMARY PAGE IN INK: lines 5 and 6 each carry a struck figure with the replacement written beside it, and the struck line 5 proves the contributions total was revised from 18,441 to 18,941 - see balance_chain. p8 is a completely BLANK, unnumbered Schedule A form page (spare stock) - zero rows, not a gap. p6 carries a TENTH ink row that is entirely scribbled out, date and name both, with NO amount: a voided entry, deliberately not emitted as a row; the page's 9 live rows close its stated 5,100 exactly. p6 also puts that page figure in the pre-printed 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' row rather than the SUBTOTAL row, and p7 strikes its TOTAL cell and writes 18,941 below the table. Every Schedule A page has the 'Complete Mailing Address' column black-barred, so donor_city/donor_state are blank on all 64 rows with 'redacted at source' in each note; on p7 the bar also swallows the tail of the aggregate row's name ('Small Contr'), which is transcribed only as far as it is legible. 15 Schedule A rows have an Occupation/Employer cell the FILER left empty - noted as such, distinct from redaction. A $500 Gastronomy IN-KIND item is booked on BOTH schedules; on Schedule B the filer struck a 794.93 total that excluded it and replaced it with 1,294.93 that includes it, so this filing is NOT a schedule-total-vs-summary-gap case. Contributions carry a +8.00 delta that is the filer's own p3 addition error; expenditures reconcile exactly.

The 64 transcribed rows sum to 18,949. The whole $8.00 sits on p3: its 15 rows sum to 3,308 against a printed SUBTOTAL of 3,300, and the single odd row (MAX GLEN WORTHINGTON, 108) was re-read in a 1200 dpi cell crop and is unambiguously 108, as was the subtotal cell (3,300). rowbands gives 15 data bands on every Schedule A page, matching the rows emitted, so no line was dropped. Filer addition error on p3, retained verbatim. No in-kind exclusion is involved: the $500 IN-KIND Gastronomy row IS inside the p7 subtotal and the grand total.

expenditures.detail: The 6 rows sum to 1,294.93 = Summary line 2 Column A = Summary line 6 (as corrected) = the 1294.93 the filer wrote into the last empty grid row on p9. NOTE the filer's own correction on that page: the printed SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells both carry a STRUCK 794.93 - the sum WITHOUT the $500 in-kind Gastronomy row - which he replaced with 1294.93 INCLUDING it. This filing therefore resolves the in-kind basis question in the filer's own hand, on the page.
